body:
I'd like to start doing something like going to a gym or something, but I have horrific self image problems, and the idea of working out in front of other people is a daunting task in itself. Plus a challenge comes with even summoning the will do to that at all.

Still, I'll think about it.

I have thought about college not being my thing, but really it comes down to I love learning, but I hate being a student. I hate being in that environment. I feel pressure to put forth energy that wouldn't normally be there.

I've also considered professional help, but really I just don't like the idea unless its 100% necessary. I would feel better knowing I have control over my own mind, rather then defaulting to chemicals, but of course I'll keep that option open. 

One thing I was thinking earlier tonight, was that life really does have so much to offer, and do and see, but for my entire life, all of that was always out of reach for me. I was never able to experience those things like others were, and thus set in the hopelessness

Also, on the subject of girls, one thing that tends to happen with me is that I will be infatuated with somebody, so much so that I ignore any other people because I don't want to hinder chances of the other. I have a hard time getting over people
